title: MiNO: Cotangent-bundle propagator learning for PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2608.15187v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific machine learning for partial differential equations commonly targets solution fields, as in physics-informed neural networks, or solution maps, as in neural operators. We study a third target: the propagator itself, a phase and amplitude in phase space. The motivation is a gap in regularity. A transported discontinuity is nonsmooth in space and time, yet the rule that moves it can be a polynomial phase carrying unit amplitude, so the object that generates an evolution can be far smoother than the field it generates. The microlocal neural operator (MiNO) learns that object, using the eikonal equation for the phase and the transport equation for the amplitude, and recovers the solution by an oscillatory integral. Sharp fronts and caustics then belong to propagation geometry rather than to a field fitted pointwise. Small residuals certify more than the reconstructed field. translated_title: MiNO：余切丛传播子学习用于偏微分方程
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15187v1 公告类型：新 摘要：面向偏微分方程的科学机器学习通常以解场为目标，如物理信息神经网络，或以解映射为目标，如神经算子。我们研究了第三个目标：传播子本身，即相空间中的相位和振幅。其动机是正则性上的差距。一个被输运的间断在空间和时间上是不光滑的，但移动它的规则可以是一个携带单位振幅的多项式相位，因此生成演化的对象可以比其生成的场光滑得多。微局域神经算子（MiNO）学习该对象，利用程函方程求解相位和输运方程求解振幅，并通过振荡积分恢复解。尖锐前沿和焦散因此属于传播几何，而非逐点拟合的场。小残差不仅验证了重建场，还验证了学习到的正则关系，即几何变换。
tldr: 该论文提出MiNO，通过学习传播子（相位和振幅）而非解场或解映射，利用程函方程和输运方程及振荡积分，实现对不光滑解的更光滑建模，并验证几何结构。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MiNO, which learns the propagator (phase and amplitude) rather than solution fields or maps, using the eikonal and transport equations with oscillatory integrals, enabling smoother modeling of nonsmooth solutions and certifying the learned geometry.
